title: Rivet: Utility-Preserving Context Control for Repository-Level Coding Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.34967v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Repository-level code generation asks an agent to implement a task requirement inside an existing repository. To produce code that works in the repository, the agent needs repository evidence, such as target locations, helper definitions, caller usages, and configuration constraints, which determine how the code should be located, integrated, and executed. Because the context budget cannot hold the entire repository, existing retrieval, compression, and structure-aware methods select context by task similarity, context length, or structural proximity, but these criteria do not directly measure whether the selected context contains this evidence. translated_title: Rivet：面向仓库级编码智能体的效用保持式上下文控制
translated_abstract: 仓库级代码生成要求智能体在现有仓库中实现某项任务需求。为了产出能在仓库中正常运行的代码，智能体需要仓库证据，例如目标位置、辅助函数定义、调用方用法和配置约束，这些证据决定了代码应如何定位、集成和执行。由于上下文预算无法容纳整个仓库，现有的检索、压缩和结构感知方法依据任务相似度、上下文长度或结构邻近性来选择上下文，但这些标准并不能直接衡量所选上下文是否包含上述证据。因此，所选上下文可能看起来与任务相关，却遗漏了实现所依赖的关键证据。我们将这种失败模式称为“上下文效用稀释”。在本文中，我们提出了 Rivet，一个在（摘要截断处）为编码智能体保持仓库证据的上下文控制框架。
tldr: 提出 Rivet 框架，通过直接保留目标位置、辅助定义、调用方用法和配置约束等仓库证据，解决现有上下文选择方法中“看似相关却缺失关键证据”的上下文效用稀释问题，从而提升仓库级编码智能体的代码生成效果。
en_tdlr: Rivet is a context control framework that directly preserves repository evidence (target locations, helper definitions, caller usages, and configuration constraints) to combat context utility dilution and improve repository-level coding agents.
